annotations.title: Market sentiment: crypto fear and funding

description: Market sentiment for crypto in one call: the Fear & Greed index with its 7-day change (alternative.me, attributed), the 10 most traded Hyperliquid perpetuals with price, 24-hour change, funding and open interest, and technical readings (RSI, MACD, moving averages) for up to three coins. No input needed. Use for a daily market brief, a trading agent's context or a risk-on, risk-off check. Example: coins=BTC,ETH,SOL. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
